jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Manager for External Design
jobs.description:
The opportunity 
At Hitachi Energy Power Transformers in Ludvika, we develop and deliver some of the world's most advanced transformers, supporting the global transition to a more sustainable energy system.
We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Manager to lead our External Design team. In this role, you will be responsible for a group of highly skilled engineers working with customer-driven projects in close collaboration with production, project management, quality, supply chain, and customers around the world.
This is a people-focused leadership role where success is built through trust, collaboration, technical excellence, and long-term competence development. You will lead an experienced team, support individual growth, and create conditions for engineers to perform their best while delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.
As part of the Power Transformers Engineering Management Team, you will contribute to the continued development of our engineering organization and help shape how we work, grow, and succeed together.
Ludvika has been at the center of power transmission innovation for more than a century. Here, you will combine local teamwork and long-term relationships with the opportunity to contribute to projects that support energy transition on a global scale.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 15–20 mechanical engineers.
Foster a culture built on collaboration, ownership, safety, and continuous learning.
Support competence development and long-term succession planning within the team.
Work closely with project management, production, quality, and other engineering functions to ensure successful project execution.
Drive continuous improvements in ways of working, quality, and operational performance.
Balance customer requirements, business priorities, and sound engineering judgement.
Contribute to the strategic development of the Mechanical Design organization.
Create an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and challenged to grow

Your background
You hold a degree in Engineering or have gained equivalent knowledge through substantial experience in a technical field.
You have experience from engineering, product development, manufacturing, project execution, or another industrial environment.
Previous leadership experience is beneficial but not required. We are equally interested in experienced leaders and strong technical professionals ready to take the next step.
Experience from transformers, power systems, heavy industry, manufacturing, mechanical design, or related technical fields is an advantage.
You enjoy working with people and understanding how to build engagement, trust, and high-performing teams.
You are comfortable balancing day-to-day operational needs with longer-term strategic objectives.
You communicate effectively with engineers, specialists, project managers, production teams, customers, and senior stakeholders.
You are fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​
Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com​
Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Håkan Blomquist, hkan.blomquist@hitachienergy.com ; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, frank.hollstedt@hitachienergy.com ; Unionen: Olle Ruzicka, olle.ruzicka@hitachienergy.com

CellaVision is a global leader in digital microscopy, delivering complete solutions that combine advanced instruments, reagents, and software to support healthcare services worldwide. Our vision is clear: To elevate healthcare through the evolution of microscopy - in a sustainable way.
We work at the forefront of technology and use advances in programming, chemistry, digital imaging, and machine learning. Joining CellaVision means playing an important role in supporting healthcare through the continued evolution of microscopy.
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Location: Lund, Sweden
Job type: Full Time, Permanent
How will you contribute?
As a member of an Applications team, you will develop algorithms and software for our analyzers that automatically locate and pre-classify cells. Working together in the Application team, you will specialize in programming and digital image processing, used in our software to automatically detect, and classify cells and other objects in blood and body fluids. You will contribute to our entire development process, from algorithm development, implementation, code reviews, and documentation, to the creation and execution of tests.
As a Senior Software Engineer your work will involve:
Act as technical lead and advisor for SW development.
Develop and maintain Windows desktop applications for lab personnel, using C++, C# and WPF.
Develop and maintain backend services for coordinating access to databases and connecting labs, using C++ and SQL.
Develop algorithms within digital imaging using C++ and Python.
Develop and maintain existing products within Product care.
Perform troubleshooting and testing as part of the quality work.
Conduct investigations and research tasks.
Review designs, reports, and source code contributions from colleagues.
Participate in cross-functional demos and forums as team representative.
Mentor more junior colleagues.

What will you bring?
M.Sc. in Engineering within an appropriate field.
Extensive experience in programming skills in C++ or C#.
Experience in machine learning is a bonus.
Very good ability to understand the overall architecture and design of large software systems.
Very good ability to take initiatives and come up with new proposals for working methods as well a strong sense of responsibility.
Very good at evaluating and solving problems.
Very good English communication skills, verbal and written.
Experience in product development involving electronics, mechanics, and software.

What We Offer
Inclusive, Innovative Culture: Work in an international, collaborative environment focused on executing big ideas and adding customer value.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible hours and reduced working hours to help maintain balance.
Job Security: We offer a collective agreement, including comprehensive insurance, occupational pension, parental leave supplements, and more.
Health & Wellbeing: We support your health with free access to a gym, wellness allowance, lunch benefits, sponsored running competitions, and discounts on gym memberships.
Modern Workplace: Enjoy a vibrant, collaborative office environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.
Team Spirit: Join us for weekly breakfasts and fun team-building activities.

Ready to Join Us?
This is a full-time position based at our CellaVision HQ in Lund, Sweden—a modern office with great infrastructure and commuting options. We’re looking for someone to start as soon as possible.
Apply Now! Follow the application form and attach your resume by November 30, at the latest. We’re excited to hear from you!
Please note that you need a valid working permit in Sweden for this role.
Diversity is in our blood.
CellaVision is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.
We decline all contact regarding services in advertising, consulting, or recruitment.
About Us
CellaVision is a global leader in digital cell morphology within hematology, and our analyzers are trusted in healthcare services around the world. We focus on innovation, working with the latest in programming, digital imaging, and machine learning to provide value to our customers. By joining us, you'll be part of a creative, skilled team shaping the future of medical technology.

Company Description
AFRY is a European leader in engineering, design, and advisory services, with a global reach. We accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society. We are 17,000 devoted experts in infrastructure, industry, energy and digitalisation, creating sustainable solutions for generations to come. 
Continuous learning of all our employees is critical for our ability to deliver on our business strategy. We need to develop the right skills and foster a culture of continuous learning to win in a complex and competitive market. We want to offer dynamic and proactive learning opportunities for our people to develop themselves.

Job Description
Group Treasury is responsible for managing and coordinating the AFRY Group’s financial activities and financial risk exposure. The team consists of five dedicated professionals and plays a central role in supporting the company’s financial stability and growth. In this position, you will join a close-knit and collaborative team in a broad and dynamic role encompassing cash management, cash flow forecasting, bank guarantees, KYC processes, treasury operations, and related back-office activities. You will gain exposure to a wide range of treasury disciplines while working closely with stakeholders across the organization.
Group Treasury is also driving several development initiatives, including the enhancement of cash management processes, banking relationships, and the treasury system landscape. As a key member of the team, you will play an integral role in shaping and implementing these initiatives, contributing to the continued development and efficiency of the treasury function.

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate with a post-secondary education in finance, economics, or equivalent. Previous experience from a corporate treasury function, particularly within treasury operations, is considered an advantage. You are able to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. As the role involves active participation in and leadership of development projects, we are looking for someone with strong coordination skills and a proven ability to drive initiatives, manage stakeholders, and contribute to successful project delivery.
Main responsibilities
Support in preparation of monthly financial statements and reporting
Manage bank and corporate guarantees
Financial payments and transactions and related administration
Responsible for banking authorizations and bank administration together with our Treasury Specialist
Management of cashpools, group netting, and liquidity forecasting
Main KYC contact person towards banks
Maintaining key processes and static data in the Treasury Management System
Actively participate in improvement projects within the Group Treasury

You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders. While being an effective team player, you are also self-driven and comfortable taking ownership of your areas of responsibility. You are an excellent communicator, with a structured yet flexible approach, enabling you to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
You are analytical, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a genuine curiosity and a passion for continuous improvement. You enjoy learning new things and contributing to the development of processes, systems, and ways of working. As AFRY is a global organization, you communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
We highly value personal qualities and look for individuals who embody AFRY's values: Brave, Devoted, and Team Player.

Additional Information
The position is a full-time, located at the headquarter in Solna, Sweden or in the office in Vantaa, Finland. You will report to the Group's Head of Treasury.
Welcome to submit your application, the deadline is 2026-12-01

We kindly ask not to be contacted by staffing and recruitment agencies or salespeople offering additional job advertisements.
At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

At AWA, we believe great results are created through collaboration, knowledge sharing and a genuine commitment to helping our clients succeed.
About AWA                                                                                                                                                      
AWA is one of Europe's leading intellectual property firms, with more than 400 colleagues across 20 offices in Europe and Asia.
We work with innovative companies ranging from ambitious start-ups to some of the world's most recognized brands, helping them create, protect and maximize the value of their intellectual assets.
At AWA, you'll collaborate across disciplines, offices and countries while developing your expertise alongside experienced colleagues.
As an employee-owned company, we share a common commitment to our clients and our future. More than half of our colleagues choose to become shareholders, creating a culture of ownership, entrepreneurship and long-term thinking.
 
About the role                                                                                                                                                
As an Associate, Intellectual Property, you will advise clients on a wide range of intellectual property matters and support them in navigating both legal and commercial challenges. You'll support clients across a broad range of intellectual property matters, including trademarks, designs, patents, domain names, agreements and disputes. Working closely with attorneys, patent consultants and paralegals, you'll help clients navigate both legal and commercial challenges while developing your own expertise and client relationships.
The role can be based in Lund, Malmö, Helsingborg or Gothenburg (Hybrid).
Your role will include:
Advising clients on intellectual property strategy and risk assessment.
Supporting clients in matters relating to trademarks, designs, patents and domain names.
Handling infringement matters, disputes and enforcement-related issues.
Drafting, reviewing and negotiating IP-related agreements.
Representing clients in interactions with authorities and courts.
Building client relationships and collaborating with colleagues across AWA.

 
Who are you?
We believe you are a curious, driven and collaborative legal professional with a genuine interest in intellectual property. You enjoy working in a collaborative and down-to-earth environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork and a low-prestige mindset are valued.
You:
Hold a law degree.
Have approximately 3-5 years of post-graduation experience, with at least some of this time spent within intellectual property law at a law firm, IP firm, in-house legal department, court or relevant authority.
Communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.
Enjoy combining legal analysis with practical and commercially relevant advice.
Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.
Take initiative, ownership and responsibility for your work.
Enjoy a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and teamwork are key.
Are curious, eager to learn and motivated to continue developing your expertise.
Experience of IP disputes, drafting and negotiating agreements, or working directly with clients is an advantage, but not required.

At AWA, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow and take on increasing responsibility while working alongside highly skilled colleagues in a collaborative and employee-owned environment.

Work with innovative companies ranging from start-ups to global market leaders.
Develop your expertise across a broad range of IP matters.
Develop strong client relationships and take increasing responsibility for client matters over time.
Learn from experienced colleagues and collaborate across disciplines
Benefit from continuous professional development, teamwork and knowledge sharing.
Join a collaborative and employee-owned company where your ideas and contributions matter.

Department of Wildlife, Fish, and Environmental Studies
We are seeking a post doc for a research project focused on understanding biodiversity in managed boreal forests. The project is part of a larger SLU research initiative (the Key Performance Indicator Project) where several researchers, postdocs and PhDs are currently involved, which opens opportunities for collaboration. 
This post doc will focus on issues that concern biodiversity conservation in managed forests by analysing species and structure data from a large-scale field survey conducted in both Sweden and Finland. The research will focus on lichens and polypore fungi, using HMSC modeling to learn how their biodiversity varies based on local forest management and landscape variables. The post doc will work at the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies in Umeå and become a part of a strong research environment focusing on restoration ecology, through empirical studies and large-scale field experiments (see https://www.slu.se/en/departments/wildlife-fish-environmental-studies/research/research-areas/restoration-ecology/). The postdoc will collaborate with the Department of Ecology, the department of Forest Ecology and Management, and the Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) in Finland. 
About the position
The post doc will analyse data from the field survey with the aim of gaining a better understanding of factors controlling species diversity in relation to forest management. They are also expected to write scientific publications together with the research group.
Your profile
The applicant should hold a PhD in ecology (or in a similar relevant subject). As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates obtained a doctoral degree within the last three years. Experience from relevant research questions (Bayesian modeling, Species distribution modeling, terrestrial ecology, nature conservation in forests, landscape ecology, conservation strategies) is a merit. Experience from statistical analyses of large data sets is considered a merit along with a strong publication record (in relation to the time since the doctoral degree). The applicant is expected to be able to take own initiative and work independently and in a group. Excellent skills in written and oral communication in English are required.   
About us
At the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies we offer a creative and stimulating environment and perform internationally recognised basic and applied research, education and environmental monitoring in the areas of biodiversity restoration and conservation, fish biology, wildlife ecology and zoonosis. The department has a large proportion of international employees and well established national and international cooperation which gives opportunities for fruitful exchange. 
For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/department-of-wildlife-fish-and-environmental-studies/
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

jobs.description:
Company Description

Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".
About us
We support managers and executives in their environmental and working environment responsibilities. We comply with requirements according to laws and certifications as well as directives within the company group and communicate continuously internally.   

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Our department drives the company's sustainability work, and your internship work will contribute to the implementation of local activities and initiatives in this area.
We also need to strengthen our team with an intern who is interested in environmental technology, has a basic understanding of ISO 14001 or similar standards.
The internship includes, among other things, environmental technology, waste management, chemical substances, reporting and project management.
We want you to have experience in problem solving, collecting and analyzing data, contributing to the development of training materials and work instructions.

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You are an organizer, happy to take on projects and organize events in the area of sustainability.
Our company language is English, but we work on production projects and it would be beneficial if you could also communicate in Swedish, so a basic knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.
Ongoing studies in Industrial Engineering and Management, Sustainability Management, Safety & Environmental Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer at Bosch Thermotechnology AB
jobs.description:
Company Description

Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort
We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description

Join the Electric Solutions group at Bosch Home Comfort, where software engineering and DevOps come together to support the development of heat pump applications. You will work closely with engineers using model-based development approaches, building a strong understanding of how their software is designed, implemented, tested, integrated, and maintained. 
You will use that understanding to shape reliable, practical tools and workflows that make continuous software development easier. From fast feedback during development to reproducible builds and releases, your work will help teams deliver high-quality software with confidence. 
Your contribution to something big:
Enable continuous development: Design and improve CI/CD workflows that support the way software teams work, from early development and integration through testing and delivery.
Enhance automation: Automate builds, tests, code analysis, packaging, and release activities, with useful feedback that helps engineers identify issues early.
Put software quality first: Consider what matters throughout the development lifecycle, including testability, reproducible builds, version control, traceability, and maintainability.
Partner with engineers: Collaborate with software teams and turn real needs into effective platform improvements.
Improve developer experience: Reduce repetitive manual work and help teams integrate and validate changes frequently and reliably.
Keep delivery systems dependable: Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot build and integration issues, and address bottlenecks across teams and sites.
Scale delivery infrastructure: Contribute to reliable and scalable build infrastructure, including cloud-based services.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you:
Education: 
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. 

Professional Experience & Skills: 
Methodologies: Solid experience in software development, CI/CD, DevOps and agile practices at scale.
Programming: Practical programming skills in Bash, Git, Python, Go, and C. 
Operating Systems: Practical knowledge with Linux and Windows systems.
DevOps Tooling: Practical knowledge of Jenkins, SonarQube, jFrog Artifactory, Bitbucket, Jira, and GitHub.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools (Ansible, Terraform) and server administration (Windows/Linux) is a plus.
Additional Tech Stack: Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, NoSQL databases (such as MongoDB), Grafana, Conan, and Maven is beneficial.

Interpersonal & Language Skills: 
Languages: Fluent in English
Working Style: Highly organized, collaborative, proactive, and structured with strong planning capabilities. 
Personality: Responsible, self-driven, eager to innovate and continuously learn, with a strong willingness to collaborate within international teams (including willingness for occasional business travel). 

Additional Information

Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys working closely with managers and employees? Do you thrive in a hands-on role where you can combine you HR expertise with a proactive and service-minded approach?
We are now looking for a Senior People Partner to join Visual Components and KUKA Group in Finland. Here, you will take on a broad and varied HR role with the opportunity to contribute to developing processes and ways of working within an international organisation.
Sounds interesting? We look forward to receiving your application! 

ABOUT THE ROLE As Senior People Partner, you will support managers and employees across Visual Components and other KUKA businesses in Finland. You will act as a trusted point of contact for everyday HR matters, providing guidance and ensuring effective HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.
The role is part of the Nordic People & Organisation (P&O) function and you will work closely with local managers, Nordic P&O colleagues and the Shared Service Centre in Hungary, contributing to consistent HR processes and ways of working.
Your main responsibilities will include:
• Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to managers and employees. • Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal movements, leave and offboarding. • Advise on HR policies, procedures and employee relations matters. • Coordinate local HR processes and ensure accurate employee records. • Support performance reviews, development initiatives and organisational changes.
The position is based at Visual Components’ office in Espoo, Finland, and you report to the Head of P&O Nordic in Sweden. 

ABOUT YOU We are looking for an experienced HR professional with a broad operational background who enjoys working hands-on and building strong relationships across the organisation. You are confident in your HR expertise, comfortable working independently and thrive in a changing international environment.
We believe you have:
• At least 10 years of experience in operational HR. • Broad knowledge of HR processes, employee relations and local employment practices. • Experience advising managers on a variety of HR matters. • A relevant university degree, preferably within HR. • Fluency in Finnish and English.
Experience from an international matrix organisation, a technology or engineering environment, or SAP SuccessFactors is considered an advantage. Swedish language skills are also a plus.
As a person, you are proactive, structured and approachable. You communicate clearly, take initiative and enjoy finding practical solutions. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues in a changing environment. 

CONTACT Does this opportunity sound interesting and align with your experience and ambitions? In this recruitment process, Visual Components and KUKA Group is partnering with Committo. For more information, please contact Linda Samuelsson at linda.samuelsson@committo.se or +46 702 16 37 52 or Sofia Erikson at sofia.erikson@committo.se or +46 73-642 75 69.
Interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you! 

ABOUT THE COMPANY KUKA is a global automation corporation with sales of around 4 billion euro and approximately 15,000 employees. The company is headquartered in Augsburg, Germany. As one of the world’s leading suppliers of intelligent automation solutions, KUKA offers customers everything they need from a single source: from robots and cells to fully automated systems and their networking in markets such as automotive, electronics, metal & plastic, consumer goods, e-commerce/retail and healthcare.
Visual Components is a leading developer of 3D manufacturing simulation software and solutions. Founded in 1999 by a team of simulation experts, we started with a humble goal – to make manufacturing design and simulation technology easy to use and accessible to manufacturing organizations of all sizes. Since 2017 Visual Components has been a part of KUKA Group.
